name: Jetpack Newsletter
line: Send new posts and newsletters to subscribers from WordPress.

free.text: Unlimited direct signups and sends; 100 imported contacts, fair use applies

cells.api: No, no email-send endpoint or SMTP relay documented

subs.math: 4,000 sends to 1,000 readers who signed up directly. Imports are limited to 100 on the Free plan. Hosting and fair-use capacity are extra.

40,000 sends to 10,000 readers who signed up directly. Imports are limited to 100 on the Free plan. Hosting and fair-use capacity are extra.
200,000 sends to 50,000 readers who signed up directly. Imports are limited to 100 on the Free plan. Hosting, fair use and capacity are extra.
